findings.evidence: Wirtinger/Similarity/Transported.lean:54-57 `def transportedCoeff ... := -((fderiv ℝ (fun w ↦ (Φ w : V →L[ℝ] V)) z 1 + transportedComplexStructure Φ z ∘L fderiv ... z I) ∘L ((Φ z).symm ...))` vs new :58-60 with `DΦ z`. A grep finds `transportedCoeff` only in these two files, so no other code depends on it.
findings.fix: Add the derivative-field argument to `transportedCoeff` (`transportedCoeff Φ DΦ`). Have the classical lemmas (`transportedCoeff_apply`, `fderiv_apply_add_transportedComplexStructure_add_eq_zero`, `continuousOn_transportedCoeff`, `memLpLoc_transportedCoeff`) pass `fderiv ℝ (fun w ↦ (Φ w : V →L[ℝ] V))`. Delete `weakTransportedCoeff`, `weakTransportedCoeff_apply` and `weakTransportedCoeff_fderiv`.
findings.issue: `weakTransportedCoeff Φ DΦ` has the same formula as `transportedCoeff Φ` (Wirtinger/Similarity/Transported.lean:54) with `fderiv` replaced by `DΦ`. The two definitions are kept side by side, joined only by `weakTransportedCoeff_fderiv`.

findings.evidence: Wirtinger/Similarity/Transported.lean:96-102 has the same `hI` proof (`rw [hσ.fderiv_restrictScalars ℝ, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars', ← map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]`) and the same simp set followed by `abel`.
findings.fix: State the algebraic identity once: for any `D : ℂ →L[ℝ] V →L[ℝ] V` and complex-linear `σ'`, `(D 1 s + Φ (σ' 1)) + J (D I s + Φ (σ' I)) + C_D (Φ s) = 0`. Use it in both the classical lemma and the weak theorem.
findings.issue: The pointwise step (the `hI : fderiv ℝ σ z I = I • fderiv ℝ σ z 1` rewrite chain, then `simp only [... transportedComplexStructure_apply, map_add, symm_apply_apply, smul_smul, I_mul_I, neg_smul, one_smul, map_neg ...]` and `abel`) repeats the end of `fderiv_apply_add_transportedComplexStructure_add_eq_zero`.

findings.evidence: Grep for `ContinuousOn (transportedComplexStructure` finds only the inline proofs at new :84 and Wirtinger/Similarity/Transported.lean:130.
findings.fix: Add `continuousOn_transportedComplexStructure (hΦ) (hΨ)` to Wirtinger/Similarity/Transported.lean, proved by `hΦ.clm_comp (continuousOn_const.clm_comp hΨ)`, and use it in both places.
findings.issue: `ContinuousOn (transportedComplexStructure Φ) Ω` is proved inline here and again in `continuousOn_transportedCoeff`. No lemma states it.

summary: `weakTransportedCoeff` defines the same coefficient as the existing `transportedCoeff` (which is just `DΦ = fderiv`), so the PR adds a second definition joined by a bridge lemma instead of generalising the first. The pointwise transport identity and the continuity of `J` are also proved twice, once in the old file and once in the new.
